$comment: The vocabulary the generator expands into commits, branches and messages.
The four traceability classes are the point of this file. `semanticSubjects`
are written to share wording with a specific sprint goal or objective and carry
no ticket key at all; `unattributedSubjects` are written to share almost nothing
with any goal. The generator asserts that each subject actually classifies the
way it was authored to, so an edit here that breaks the intent fails the build
rather than quietly changing the report.
